The camera stands on the LEFT SIDE of the room and looks OBLIQUELY toward a tall window on the RIGHT-HAND WALL, a clear three-quarter side view. We are NOT facing the window straight on. The window, deep sill and desk are seen FROM THE SIDE at approximately 30 degrees to a frontal view. Show the visible thickness and SIDE REVEAL of the window's left jamb. Vertical frame lines remain vertical, but the horizontal sill, its moldings, and desk edges slope noticeably DOWNWARD toward the RIGHT. They recede toward a vanishing point well beyond the LEFT edge, around the middle height of the image. Right-side objects are closer and larger. The table is a receding trapezoid, NOT a horizontal rectangle. Foreground lampshade occupies the near right corner; flowers stand farther back on the window sill. The four vase bases are arranged in depth, NOT aligned in one straight level row like a product lineup. The book is seen in angled perspective. Avoid frontal elevation, flat symmetrical staging, horizontal desk front, straight-on window.

The left bottle x33–42% is tall with almost straight cylindrical sides and sloping shoulders, y65–85%; second shorter faceted vessel x43–51%, y69–86%; small plain tumbler in FRONT at x49–56%,y77–88%; right square-shouldered bottle x56–64%, y69–87%. Long sparse stems, flowers point in assorted directions, petals softly cupped rather than all face-on.

Closest right half is cut off by image edge. Delicate plain ivory pleats, slim gold-gray linework. Lamp stem/base only at x94–100%,y88–100%, cropped.

Diffuse neutral daytime illumination, subtle material shading; NO bright beams, painted leaf shadows, rainbow streaks, or droplets: these will be animated as separate layers. Sage wall and luminous ivory cloth; pale pink lavender and mint flowers. No foreground lilies or chair in this cropped view. The viewer must immediately read the scene as a SIDE VIEW of the window and receding desktop, never as a frontal still life. Keep the composition naturally asymmetrical, with depth between curtain, vases and the large near lamp.
